versions.content: EcucDestinationUriPolicy.destinationUriNesting- Contract is set to vertexOfTargetContainer If the attribute EcucDestina- tionUriPolicy.destinationUriNestingContract is set to vertexOfTar- getContainer , then the attributes • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.container , • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.reference , and • EcucDestinationUriPolicy.parameter are expressing the constraint that the listed elements shall have corresponding child elements (identified by a matching pair of shortName s) that exist somewhere in the sub-structure of EcucContainerDef (the target of the URI-based reference), but not towards the EcucContainerDef itself. It is allowed that the EcucContainerDef (the target of the URI-based reference) has additional child elements that are not represented in the definition of the EcucDesti- nationUriPolicy .
